overview.p0: The Gausin Automated CIP System is engineered for reliable, hygienic performance in demanding industrial environments. Fully automated Clean-in-Place systems with PLC-controlled pre-rinse, caustic wash, acid wash, and final rinse sequences.
overview.p1: Each unit is custom-designed to your capacity, product characteristics, and plant layout requirements with SS 304/316L contact surfaces, validated process design, and full documentation.
overview.p2: Gausin provides complete engineering support from process design and fabrication through installation, commissioning, and after-sales service.

advantages.0.title: Fully Automated Sequencing
advantages.0.desc: PLC runs pre-rinse, caustic, acid, and sanitize cycles without manual valve switching.
advantages.1.title: Validated Cleaning Protocols
advantages.1.desc: Temperature, time, and chemical concentration logged for FSSAI and audit compliance.
advantages.2.title: Chemical Recovery & Reuse
advantages.2.desc: Caustic and acid solutions returned to storage tanks, reducing chemical consumption and cost.
advantages.3.title: Multi-Circuit Coverage
advantages.3.desc: Single CIP skid cleans pasteurizer, tanks, fillers, and pipework across the entire plant.
advantages.4.title: Conductivity-Based Rinse
advantages.4.desc: Inline conductivity sensor confirms chemical removal before next production cycle starts.
advantages.5.title: Reduced Cleaning Downtime
advantages.5.desc: Optimized flow paths and return pumping cut total CIP cycle time vs. manual cleaning.
how.0.title: Pre-Rinse
how.0.desc: Warm water flushes product residue from tanks, pipes, and heat exchangers before chemical wash.
how.1.title: Caustic Wash
how.1.desc: Alkaline solution circulated at set temperature and flow to remove fat and protein deposits.
how.2.title: Intermediate Rinse
how.2.desc: Fresh water rinse removes caustic before acid cycle; conductivity sensor confirms rinse completion.
how.3.title: Acid Wash & Sanitize
how.3.desc: Nitric or phosphoric acid removes mineral scale; optional sanitizer step for microbiological control.
how.4.title: Final Rinse & Recovery
how.4.desc: Final water rinse leaves circuits clean; spent solutions recovered to CIP tanks for reuse where configured.
